JWT.definition: Signed token that verifies identity without a database lookup. [docs](https://jwt.io/introduction)

D1.definition: Cloudflare's managed SQLite database. Queries run at the network edge — no servers to manage. [docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/)

KV.definition: Cloudflare's global key-value store. Data cached worldwide for fast retrieval. [docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/)

turnstile.definition: Cloudflare's invisible bot detection. No CAPTCHA, no user friction — runs on submit. [docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/)

resend.definition: Email API for transactional emails — receipts, alerts, notices. [docs](https://resend.com/docs)

workers.definition: Cloudflare's serverless execution environment. Code runs at the network edge, close to users — no servers to manage. [docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/)

async.definition: A task that runs in the background without slowing things down — the booking goes through while the email sends itself.

playwright.definition: End-to-end testing framework that drives real browsers headlessly. [docs](https://playwright.dev/)

lighthouse.definition: Automated tool for auditing performance, accessibility, and SEO. [docs](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/)

vitest.definition: Unit test framework for Vite projects — runs tests natively in Node.js. [docs](https://vitest.dev/)

CMS.definition: Content management system — software for creating and managing digital content without writing code.
